Setup.About.WhatItIs.Title: What this is
Setup.About.WhatItIs.Summary: A second-screen companion for Escape from Tarkov.
Setup.About.WhatItIs.Detail1: It runs in its own window, on a second monitor or a tablet.
Setup.About.WhatItIs.Detail2: It reads the screenshots and logs the game writes itself,
Setup.About.WhatItIs.Detail3: and public game data, and shows maps, quests, hideout needs and loot decisions.
Setup.About.WhatItIs.Detail4: It never draws over the game.
Setup.About.AntiCheat.Title: What it never does
Setup.About.AntiCheat.Summary: It only reads what the game already wrote.
Setup.About.AntiCheat.Detail1: It never reads or writes the game's memory, injects code or hooks the renderer, or looks at the game's network traffic.
Setup.About.AntiCheat.Detail2: It never sends keyboard, mouse or controller input, and never automates flea, inventory or combat actions.
Setup.About.AntiCheat.Detail3: It has no overlay, no radar and no live enemy tracking.
Setup.About.Predictions.Title: Estimates and history
Setup.About.Predictions.Summary: Anything predicted says so. Nothing is a live position.
Setup.About.Predictions.Detail1: Traffic and spawn views are modelled from static spawns, map topology, elapsed raid time and past evidence,
Setup.About.Predictions.Detail2: and are labelled Historical, Modelled or Predicted.
Setup.About.Predictions.Detail3: Where freshness or confidence could change a decision, it is shown beside the figure.
Setup.About.Notices.Title: Open-source notices
Setup.About.Notices.Detail1: Every component and its licence is listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md in the source repository,
Setup.Info.Stored.Title: What is kept on this computer
Setup.Info.Stored.Summary: Your progress, the game data it downloaded, your raid history and settings.
Setup.Info.Stored.Detail1: Profiles and their quest, hideout and wishlist progress; the cached public game data;
Setup.Info.Stored.Detail2: raid history; and your settings all live in the data folder.
Setup.Info.Stored.Detail3: Nothing in it is uploaded unless you turn sharing on or send a report.
Setup.Info.LeavesComputer.Title: What leaves this computer
Setup.Info.LeavesComputer.Summary: Game data requests, update checks, and only what you choose to share.
Setup.Info.LeavesComputer.Detail1: Game data is fetched from json.tarkov.dev and the request names only the game mode and language.
Setup.Info.LeavesComputer.Detail2: The update check asks the update feed for a newer build.
Setup.Info.LeavesComputer.Detail3: Sharing, when it is on, sends your position, marks and waypoints to the people in your room.
Setup.Info.LeavesComputer.Detail4: A problem report is sent only when you press Report a problem.
Setup.Info.LeavesComputer.Detail5: There is no telemetry and no screenshot upload.
Setup.Info.CaptureRetention.Title: Screenshots
Setup.Info.CaptureRetention.Summary: The app keeps no copy of a screenshot it reads.
Setup.Info.CaptureRetention.Detail1: It reads the game's own screenshot files and keeps what it recognised, not the picture.
Setup.Info.CaptureRetention.Detail3: it moves the game's own files to the recycle bin, and it is off until you turn it on.
Setup.Info.SharingScope.Title: Sharing
Setup.Info.SharingScope.Summary: Off until you join a room.
Setup.Info.SharingScope.Detail1: Joining a room shares your name, your map position taken from your screenshots' names,
Setup.Info.SharingScope.Detail2: and your marks and waypoints with the people in that room and the tablets you paired, through the relay.
Setup.Info.SharingScope.Detail3: If you turn it on, it also shares the quests you are working on.
Setup.Info.SharingScope.Detail4: It does not share your screenshots or files, and leaving the room stops it.
Setup.Info.Reports.Title: Problem reports
Setup.Info.Reports.Summary: A short summary, with no names, paths or pictures.
Setup.Info.Reports.Detail1: The report holds counts, build numbers and yes/no facts about your setup.
Setup.Info.Reports.Detail2: It has no player names, file paths, screenshots, log lines or credentials,
Setup.Info.Reports.Detail3: and it is sent only when you press Report a problem.
Setup.Info.Methodology.Title: Where the game data comes from
Setup.Info.Methodology.Summary: Public data from tarkov.dev, cached here.
Setup.Info.Methodology.Detail1: Items, maps, quests, hideout, traders and crafts come from the public json.tarkov.dev feed for the profile's game mode.
Setup.Info.Methodology.Detail2: The Data section shows when it was last fetched and how much of it there is.
